surface: dropin (public webgpu.h ABI); one harness source linked per provider, compiled with -DDOE_PHASE_BACKEND_METAL
workloadOrigin: unchanged amd-host C1 workloads; inputs manifest byte-identical to the amd-host and intel-host manifests (afe4e1d3...); independent CPU oracle on every iteration outside the timed interval

sampling.orders: all 24 permutations of the 4 providers, cycled

timing: CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW (Darwin CLOCK_MONOTONIC is quantized to 1 us); host clock, not GPU timestamps
phases: identical to amd-host contract-c1.json; complete = compile + pipeline + resources + sum of every iteration's operation + teardown
statistics: per-pair ratio provider/control; median ratio, bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20261029), provider-faster pair count
gateLimits: Unchanged from b2/b3/m1r/m2r: idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity (tools/mac_window.py, hash below).
gpuLock: Every timed window runs under `flock /tmp/doe-gpu-timing.lock`, the host-wide lock shared with other agents' Metal correctness and timing runs, held for that window only; scheduling (settle loop, tools/wait_quiet.sh) runs outside the lock.

host.label: apple-host
host.machine: Apple M3 (8 CPU cores, 10 GPU cores), 24 GiB unified memory
host.power: AC power, battery 100% charged at freeze, low-power mode off; the power source must stay unchanged within a window; every window's gate.json records the power source and battery level before and after
host.sharedUse: desktop session with the external display, browser, terminal and agent sessions; no computer-use or screen-capture session; at freeze the top processes were this agent (9%) and WindowServer (5%). Earlier the same day another session's one-core Python jobs and a busy Chrome renderer ran; windows are scheduled by the run script's settle loop and tools/wait_quiet.sh.

rebuild: Libraries built with ZERO_AR_DATE=1 make -C runtime/c/native -j8 BUILD=<work>/build-<name>/native CC=clang from a git archive of main e76522a50, candidate patch applied with patch -p1. Dawn d04f88359 is the same rebuilt library as contract-completion.
experiment: Owner decision 2026-10-31 (revision of decision 2): start the shader-cache identity worker when a Metal adapter is requested, before the adapter opens; the adapter owns the digest (no process-wide state), every device of that adapter shares it, and final adapter release joins a never-joined worker (identity2-candidate.patch). native_shader_cache_identity is unchanged. D3D12 keeps its device-start worker. Control is main e76522a50.

providers.cand: e76522a50 + identity2-candidate.patch, built the same way
providers.dawn: source-built Dawn d04f88359391a12375c1a3e948a0b2dcb4c97a18, CMake Release, monolithic shared, Metal only
providers.dawn-aa: byte-identical copy of the dawn harness binary (A/A control)

validity: every process status ok with all 32 iterations oracle-checked
every provider reports a Metal adapter that is not a CPU adapter
A/A: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median ratio within [0.95,1.05] and its CI95 contains 1, per workload
window gate (tools/mac_window.py) valid: power source and low-power mode unchanged, no thermal warning, idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity
acceptance.mechanismRule: cand/main: pipelineNs CI95 upper < 1.0 on vector_scale_add_262k and image_rgba_invert_1024, and every noRegress metric, compileNs, pipelineNs and setupNs included, CI95 lower <= 1.05 on every workload. Correctness recorded before freezing: all 81 Metal physical clients match main per client; backends/metal check, sdk-abi, native-check and native-graphics-check pass. Identity: a diagnostic build compared the adapter digest with an inline recomputation: equal in 4 of 4 harness processes and for both devices of one adapter (the second device took the already-joined result), same digest across processes.
acceptance.invalidWindows: an invalid window is retained, never used for the verdict, and rerun fresh once under the unchanged contract
acceptance.claimBoundary: A pass accepts the mechanism for the Metal C runtime on apple-host only; it does not by itself make a scoped win against Dawn and says nothing about Vulkan or D3D12.

relation: New prospective experiment. contract-identity keeps its FAIL verdict.
